AHS 13 Part 4: Is Ben an Ally or a Pawn? American Horror Story 13 Ep 11 & 12 🕯️

short // Oct 25, 2026

Watch on YouTube

Ben brought Myrtle back? And that clears his background check? 🕯️

This is Part 4 of my American Horror Story 13 breakdown, covering episodes 11 and 12, "Madison's Happy Ending" and "Sisters in Arms."

⚠️ Spoilers for American Horror Story 13 through episode 12.

Madison, girl

Madison, I'm rooting for you. But "my dad is Satan" belongs in the talking stage, not after.

Wait, they're twins?

And speaking of family: Fiona and Constance are twins? And Sister Jude is their mother?

Huh. So are Tate, Kai and James March cousins now, or triplets? Somebody get a DNA test and a whiteboard.

(That triplets bit is a casting joke, since it's the same actor. Not confirmed lore.)

The ambush

Then Cordelia and Queenie walk straight into an ambush. Hold on. Who knew they were coming?

Ally or pawn?

I'm not calling Ben a traitor. He gets taken down too. But here's my theory from last time: Ben might be sincere and still be somebody else's pawn.

(That's my XFD theory, not confirmed.)

Catch up on the series: Part 1, Part 2 and Part 3.

Sources: Fiction Horizon: AHS 13 schedule, Wikipedia: American Horror Story season 13

Quick answers

What are AHS 13 episodes 11 and 12 called? Episode 11 is "Madison's Happy Ending" and episode 12 is "Sisters in Arms."

Are Fiona and Constance twins in American Horror Story 13? In episodes 11 and 12, Fiona and Constance are revealed to be twins, with Sister Jude as their mother.

When is the AHS 13 finale? Episode 13, the finale, is listed for October 29, 2026.
